title: 一碗面条 Yì wǎn miàntiáo — One bowl of noodles
summary: An old notebook recipe explains why one bowl of noodles tastes like a childhood kitchen.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: Dà Jiāng zài chéng lǐ gōngzuò, hěn máng.
body.en: Da Jiang works in the city and is very busy.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: tā měi tiān chī wàimiàn de fàn.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 一天晚上，他想起了奶奶的面条。
body.py: yì tiān wǎnshang, tā xiǎngqǐ le nǎinai de miàntiáo.
body.en: One night he thinks of his grandmother noodles.

body.speaker: 大江
body.py: nàgè wèidao wǒ yìzhí zài zhǎo.
body.en: I have been looking for that taste all along.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: tā gěi jiā lǐ dǎ le diànhuà.

body.speaker: 妈妈
body.py: miàntiáo hěn jiǎndān, nǐ xiān shāo shuǐ.
body.en: Noodles are simple, boil the water first.

body.speaker: 大江
body.py: wǒ jì bu zhù, nǐ zài shuō yí biàn.
body.en: I cannot keep it in mind, say it again.

body.speaker: 妈妈
body.zh: 水开了放面，面软了放青菜。
body.py: shuǐ kāi le fàng miàn, miàn ruǎn le fàng qīngcài.
body.en: When the water boils add the noodles, when they soften add the greens.

body.speaker: 妈妈
body.py: zuìhòu jiā yìdiǎn yán hé yóu.
body.en: At the end add a little salt and oil.

body.speaker: 妈妈
body.py: yán shǎo yìdiǎn, nǎinai chī de dàn.
body.en: Less salt, your grandmother eats bland food.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: guō tài xiǎo, miàn fàng bu xià.
body.en: The pot is too small and the noodles do not fit.

body.speaker: 大江
body.py: wǒ mǎi yí ge dà guō.
body.en: I will buy a big pot.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.py: dì èr tiān tā zuò le yì wǎn.
body.en: The next day he makes one bowl.

body.speaker: 同事
body.py: zhè miàn xiāng, bǐ shítáng de hǎochī.
body.en: These noodles smell good, better than the canteen.

body.speaker: 大江
body.py: zhè shì wǒ nǎinai de zuòfǎ.
body.en: This is my grandmother way of making them.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 下班以后，他买了一本本子。
body.py: xiàbān yǐhòu, tā mǎi le yì běn běnzi.
body.en: After work he buys a notebook.

body.speaker: 旁白
body.zh: 他把那四行字写了下来。
body.py: tā bǎ nà sì háng zì xiě le xiàlái.
body.en: He writes down those four lines.

blocks.title: Words in this story
body: 烧水 shāo shuǐ — to boil water
做法 zuòfǎ — method of cooking
写下来 xiě xiàlái — to write down

blocks.body: Think about it: Which four steps does the mother give? Try saying them in Chinese with 先 xiān (first), 再 zài (then), and 最后 zuìhòu (at the end).
